title: Proxy-branch rate-limited shadow mirroring with tenant chargeback
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We need a safe shadow-mirroring pipeline that lets teams run canary and A/B experiments with realistic production traffic while guaranteeing cost isolation and preventing noisy tenants from exhausting mirror budgets. Current ad-hoc mirroring approaches either (a) duplicate all traffic which blows budget, (b) lack per-tenant throttles leading to noisy neighbor effects, or (c) reuse production caches and contaminate observability.

Proposal: Implement a proxy-branch component in the edge router that performs sampled request duplication into a dedicated mirror plane. The proxy-branch will enforce per-tenant budget tokens (chargeback-aware), support adaptive sampling (priority based on recent drop in model quality or rollout phase), and attach metadata that keeps mirrored requests logically and cache-isolated from primary runtime. The mirror plane will be backed by separate compute pools and billing meters so mirrored compute is chargeable to tenant cost centers. Include automatic quarantine and rollback triggers when mirrored traffic cost or error rates cross thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Proxy-branch duplicates a sampled subset of live requests to a dedicated mirror endpoint without adding >1ms median latency to happy path
Per-tenant mirror budgets are enforced: tenants can set monthly mirrored-token budgets and mirror requests are denied/logged once exhausted
Adaptive sampler supports three modes: fixed-rate, priority-based (error/quality-driven), and exploratory (uniform for early canaries)
Mirror plane uses separate KV prefix namespaces and does not share production KV caches (no cache pollution)
Billing records for mirrored compute appear in tenant chargeback reports and are available in Console cost breakdown within 24 hours

Auto-quarantine policy triggers when mirrored compute for a tenant exceeds configured rate-of-spend or when mirrored model regression >= configured threshold; quarantine must prevent further mirroring and notify SRE and customer owner
tasks: Design proxy-branch API and open RFC (include sampling knobs and token-bucket semantics)
Implement proxy-branch middleware in edge-router (duplicate path, async fanout, minimal headers)
Add mirror-budget store: per-tenant token bucket with replenishment window and admin APIs
Create mirror plane runtime configs: isolated KV namespaces, separate model pools, and separate metrics tags
Instrument billing pipeline to include mirror compute and store chargeback dimensions
Implement adaptive sampler service to adjust sampling weights from Console/experiment config
Add quarantine controller that listens to cost/quality signals and flips tenant mirror allow=false
E2E tests: latency impact, quota exhaustion, cache isolation, correct billing labeling
Create runbook and Console UI surface for tenants to manage mirror budgets and view mirror spend
rollout_plan: Phased rollout: 1) dev-only testing against synthetic traffic (2 weeks), 2) internal dogfood with platform team (2 weeks) using fixed-rate sampling at 0.5% and strict budgets, 3) limited external beta for trusted customers with explicit chargeback and opt-in, 4) GA when billing, monitoring, quarantine and docs are complete. Each phase will publish a short checklist; gate to next phase requires no critical regressions and stable mirror billing for 48h.
monitoring: Latency-Delta: distribution of proxy latency before/after branch to ensure <1ms median overhead
Mirror-Cost-Per-Tenant: daily spend and token consumption metrics
Cache-Pollution-Check: KV hit-rate on prod namespace compared to baseline
Quarantine-Events: counts and reasons; alert on repeated quarantines
